root_idea.summary: The root centers on emptiness and falling: an unfilled space or air, and movement downward into a fall or depth.
root_idea.development: From emptiness and descent develop the senses of vacant space, abyss, falling and overthrowing. Desire is treated as an inclination that can draw a person away from what is right or downward into harm.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Form I citation form هَوَى.
Displayed under the normalized Form X citation form اِسْتَهْوَى.
The Quranic plural أَهْوَاء is represented under the supported singular noun citation form هَوًى.
Displayed as the substantivized active-participle noun هَاوِيَة.
Displayed under the nominal citation forms هَوًى and هَوَاءٌ, whose Quranic occurrences in this QAC group include desire and emptiness.

senses.definition: To fall, descend, or plunge downward; contextually, to perish through a fall.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes downward movement and being swept or carried downward or away; the resulting sense may be perishing or destruction.

senses.definition: To incline toward, desire, or be drawn to something.
senses.usage_conditions: May describe an inclination toward a person or place, or what the self desires.

senses.definition: To bring something down or overthrow it.
senses.usage_conditions: A causative use represented in the Quranic occurrence أَهْوَىٰ; it expresses causing a fall rather than merely falling oneself.

senses.definition: To entice, lead astray, or cause someone to follow a desire.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction takes a person as the one led or enticed, especially toward misguided desire.

senses.definition: Desire or personal inclination; in Quranic usage, often a vain or blameworthy desire opposed to revealed guidance.
senses.usage_conditions: The singular هَوًى denotes an individual's inclination or desire, while أَهْوَاء can denote the differing desires of individuals or groups.
In the Quranic expression describing hearts as هَوَاءٌ, it denotes hearts left empty or void rather than a separate desire.

senses.definition: An abyss or deep pit; in the Quran, the Pit into which the ruined person falls.
senses.usage_conditions: A substantivized active participle with an eschatological application to the fire or abyss of punishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Love or attachment; an affective inclination toward something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general affection or attachment sense, distinct from the specifically blameworthy-desire use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beloved person or object of love.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may function as an inflectionally flexible noun for a beloved or object of affection.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Opinions or doctrines that diverge from the right way or the truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural conventional use, especially in the expression أهل الأهواء, “people of erroneous opinions.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression هَوَتْ أُذُنُهُ, to hear a confused, humming, or singing sound.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression concerning the sound heard by the ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A curse or expression of wonder implying that the person's mother has fallen or perished.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A fixed exclamatory or insulting expression, not a literal statement about a particular mother.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extend or stretch the hand toward something nearby in order to take it; to reach for or take hold of something, and also to signal with an object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction distinguishes reaching toward a nearby object from reaching toward a distant one; it includes reaching for a sword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A deep hollow, cavity, pit, or depressed place in the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun covers a deep descent or low place as well as a hollow or cavity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression جعل الأمر هوة واحدة, to make a matter uniform or reduce it to one consistent state.
A mortar or vessel in which substances are pounded or bruised.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical item is reported with an etymological connection to هَاوُونٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cavity or depth of a well.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction referring specifically to the hollow portion of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The space between two mountains, or a pit or hollow dug into the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun applies both to a natural gap or descent and to an excavated hollow.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The construction means to make something fall.
Extension of the hand and reaching construction.
Love, attachment, inclination, and blameworthy desire are covered by the listed targets.
Plural use for opinions diverging from truth.
Deep hollow, pit, or depressed place.
Idiomatic use for making a matter uniform.
The vacant or empty thing is covered by the void sense.
Space between mountains or excavated pit.

cautions: The supplied QAC nominal group for هَوَآء includes both the Quranic desire forms written هَوَىٰ and the occurrence meaning emptiness; they are retained as distinct senses under a combined citation display rather than silently conflated.

The supplied QAC analysis places the Quranic surface form أَهْوَىٰ at 53:53 in the Form I group, while the Lane evidence separately catalogs أَهْوَى as Form IV. The artifact follows the supplied QAC morphology and retains the explicitly attested causative “bring down or overthrow” use.
The displayed nominal occurrence count of 28 aggregates the 11 occurrences in the هَوَآء group and the 17 occurrences in the merged أَهْوَاء group.
